top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before December.

Road-specific control matters at Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo. Practice on rolling hills: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 93 miles.
64ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
5,988ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
At Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on rolling hills can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,988ft of climbing on rolling hills does to your power file on race day.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
5,988ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

race_overlay.weather: December in Hazza bin Zayed Stadium, Al Ain to Sheikh Zayed Festival, Al Wathba, Abu Dhabi, UAE — Desert climate in late December: mild daytime temps, dry with low precipitation risk. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Bike Abu Dhabi Gran Fondo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling hills to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 93 miles of rolling hills in Hazza bin Zayed Stadium, Al Ain to Sheikh Zayed Festival, Al Wathba, Abu Dhabi, UAE.
